en.blurb_baron: %{name} is the Baron of the b1_t. The Baron makes all decisions for their people and is responsible for keeping things running smoothly. A territory with an injured, ill, or absent Baron can quickly fall to ruin, so keeping their Baron safe and protected is every Regent, doctor, and Clipper's top priority.
en.blurb_regent: %{name} is the Barony's Regent. The Regent is the head of all Clippers, and the Baron's first line of defense. They are very well respected, and often allowed into the Baron's close circle of advisors. A Regent's first duty in life is to serve their Baron. As such, Regents are not allowed to have kits.
en.blurb_heir: %{name} is the heir of the b1_t. The heir is chosen by the Baron to take over the throne upon the Baron's death. Instead of being trained solely in fighting or hunting, the heir is raised and taught the political intricacies of Baronship. Heirs are typically direct descendants of their Baron, but this custom is not always followed.
en.blurb_clipper: %{name} is a Clipper. Clippers are cats trained to defend their Baron, even at the cost of their life or someone else's. They're skilled in deadly battle moves and report to the Regent. Clippers, along with Regents, and sometimes Barons, are responsible for training colts.
en.blurb_elder: %{name} is an elder. They have spent many moons serving their Baron and have earned their rest. Whether they have retired from being a Regent, doctor, Clipper or cog, elders are well respected in the Barony.
en.blurb_doctor: %{name} is a doctor. Doctors take care of the cats in the Barony. Doctors are often some of the most educated and clever cats in their territory, as they harbour more knowledge than even your averagr Baron. They are not expected to hunt like cogs or fight like Clippers.
en.blurb_cog: %{name} is a cog. Cogs work for their Barons by gathering prey and supplies, as well as maintaining the camp. Depending on what their Baron wishes, cogs may participate in reinforcing walls, setting traps, or gathering materials for export. They are not trained to fight or heal. Every cat is destined to grow up as a cog unless chosen as a colt or born as an heir.
en.blurb_colt: %{name} is a colt. Cogs or kittens can be chosen as colts from six moons of age, when they are then trained by Clippers to defend the Baron with their claws. Colts have special bonds with their Clippers, being trained exclusively by them.
en.blurb_apprentice_doctor: %{name} is an apprentice doctor, training to become a full doctor. Kittens can be made apprentice doctors at six moons of age, where they will learn how to heal.
en.blurb_kitten: %{name} is a kitten. All cats below the age of six moons are considered kits. Kits are prohibited from leaving camp in order to protect them from the dangers of the Badlands. They are protected by every cat in the Barony and always eat first.
en.blurb_newborn: %{name} is a newborn kitten. All cats below the age of six moons are considered kits. Kits are prohibited from leaving camp in order to protect them from the dangers of the Badlands. They are protected by every cat in the Barony and always eat first.
en.blurb_unknown: %{name} has an unknown rank. I guess they want to make their own way in life!
